failing_tests.detail: In commit 3dd1dfb59, services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_journal_runtime_contract.py added 'import services.control_plane.bff.main' inside paper_factory_probe so the probe would build the app with production dependency resolution without stand-ins. However, test_bff_test_architecture.py performs an AST scan of all test suites under BFF_DIR to enforce that non-composition test files do not import the composition root main.py unless admitted to composition_allowlist. Because test_journal_runtime_contract.py is a non-composition contract suite, importing main.py in its file AST directly caused the live scanner to detect it as an unauthorized non-whitelisted main importer.
